name: Seal of the Earth

description: Seal of the Earth: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Seal of the Earth lies here, with three recessed alcoves for the Amethyst Runestone, the Opal Runestone, and the Diamond Runestone.

clips.title: Completion
